visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing silver-rimmed glasses and a lime green "MIKE" hoodie, sits at a mahjong table. She is actively arranging green-backed mahjong tiles with her hands. The background consists of light yellow acoustic foam panels. (2) A young man with dark hair and glasses, wearing a black sweatshirt with white text, plays mahjong against her. He holds a mahjong-shaped chocolate in his mouth and discards a "4 Bamboo" tile. (3) A third man in a blue graphic t-shirt is seen in a brief cutaway, holding a bag of chips and a can of green tea, watching the game with a focused, chewing expression. (4) The woman looks frustrated, gesturing with her hands while the man with glasses displays a bitten "West" wind chocolate tile on the table. (5) A hand opens various Cona's branded gift boxes (dark blue and red) revealing rows of mahjong-shaped chocolates. Close-ups show a chocolate being pulled out from a tray. (6) The man with glasses holds a "Zhao Cai" red card and a stuffed tiger keychain. Hands then flip through colorful instruction cards and "Today's Fortune" cards featuring mahjong symbols.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Sharp percussive clicks and thuds from mahjong tiles hitting the table dominate the mix. A male voice calls out mahjong terminology with a neutral tone and moderate speed. A female voice responds with rising intonation and high arousal. (2) Vocal shift as the woman expresses frustration through louder, slightly strained speech. The rhythmic tile clicks continue in the background at a high frequency. (3) A sudden high-tempo Electronic Pop BGM swells as the skit transitions. A male narrator begins speaking at a fast pace with highly professional enunciation and enthusiastic pitch contours. (4) Distinct crunching and biting sounds of food are audible, followed by the rustling of cardboard boxes and plastic trays. The narrator maintains a high energy level, focusing on product descriptions. (5) Sound of paper cards being shuffled and flipped creates a dry, rustling acoustic texture. The BGM maintains a consistent beat with strong electronic percussion until the end of the clip.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedy Skit -> Product Reveal -> Feature Breakdown -> Collaboration Intro -> Interactive Elements -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video promotes Cona's mahjong-shaped chocolate gift sets for the 2025 Chinese New Year. It captures the viewer's interest with a comedic mahjong-themed skit before transitioning into an energetic product showcase detailing the set's flavors, packaging, and a special collaboration with a local temple.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of the product, brand logo, and detailed pricing/packaging information provided by the narrator.
